oil.when: 2015 E-Class Coupe and Cabriolet with the ASSYST PLUS service display
steps: Have the oil, filter and scheduled service done first; the reminder is tied to the service actually being carried out.
The 2015 owner's manual gives no driver reset. It says the workshop that does the service resets the ASSYST PLUS service display afterward.

To see when the next service is due: switch the ignition on, use the left and right arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Serv. menu, use the up and down arrows to choose ASSYST PLUS, and press OK.
If the service display was reset by mistake, the manual says a qualified workshop can correct it.

tpms.when: 2015 E-Class Coupe and Cabriolet with the tire pressure monitor in the cluster Service menu
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker in the driver's door opening (or the table inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the left and right arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Service menu.
Use the up and down arrows to choose Tire Pressure and press OK.
Press the down arrow button. The display asks whether to use the current pressures as the new reference values.
Press OK to confirm. The display shows that the tire pressure monitor has restarted. Press the back button instead if you want to cancel.
Drive for a few minutes so the car can check the pressures and store them.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: The 2015 E-Class Coupe and Cabriolet owner's manual says the workshop resets the ASSYST PLUS service reminder after the service, so no driver steps are given for it. Sedans and wagons of other years were not checked.
